title: fix(app-shell): a source-language menu rename over an inline locale map keeps the other locales
body:
Fixes #36876
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:搭建者在设计模式里用应用的源语言给菜单项改名时,如果这个菜单项的名称是写在一起的多语言名称,保存后只换掉源语言那一条,其他语言的名称都保留;以前会把其他语言的名称全部丢掉。
- 为什么做:属于设计模式菜单编辑这一组工作,修的是上一轮"改名按语言落地"留下的数据丢失漏洞。
- 出错会怎样:最坏是某个菜单项改名后显示的还是旧名称,不会再丢失其他语言;改动只在保存菜单这一步,撤回这一次改动即可恢复原行为。
- 要你做什么:无

## What changes

A menu entry's `label` may be an inline locale map (`I18nLabelSchema`), for example `{ en: 'Orders', 'zh-CN': '订单' }`. A design-mode rename typed in the app's source language over an entry shown by its stored label goes to the stored label (the routing ruling of objectstack#36363 as relaxed by objectstack#36504, unchanged here). Until now that write replaced the whole map with the typed string, so every other locale's text was lost from the stored app.

- `splitLabelEdits` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/designModeMenuModel.ts`) now merges a stored-label rename into an inline-map label instead of replacing it: the typed name goes into the entry the editor showed for the session language, a cleared name drops only that entry, and every other locale is kept. A plain-string label is replaced as before.
- The entry is chosen by Studio's own nav-label writers, `renamedLabel` / `clearedLabel` (`views/metadata-admin/previews/navItemLabel.ts`), which wrap `setLocalized` / `clearLocalized` from `@object-ui/i18n`. Nothing new is exported and no copy of the key choice is made.
- `splitLabelEdits` takes the session language (`shownIn`) as a new fifth argument; `prepareAppMenuSave` passes `input.labels.language`, the language `DesignModeMenu`'s `labelOf` shows each label in.
- The routing (stored label or translation) is unchanged.

**Which entry counts as "the source-language entry".** It is the entry the builder was shown, keyed by the session language and not by the deployment's `sourceLocale` code: the exact tag, else the bare language (`en` under `en-US`), else, where the platform splits a language by script, a same-script sibling. A map with none of these gains an entry under the session tag. Keying by the session language keeps read and write symmetric: a key chosen from `sourceLocale` could write `en` while an `en-US` reader is shown an `en-US` entry, and the rename would then not show.

**Precondition measured before any code (seat's condition).** `translateApp` (`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`, `translateNav`) copies each navigation node and replaces `label` only when the catalog holds `apps.APP.navigation.ID.label`. An inline map is therefore served as the map itself, `labelGoesToTranslation`'s `JSON.stringify` comparison finds served equal to stored, and the rename goes to the stored label. A throwaway test (not committed) ran the stored app through `translateApp`, both with no bundle and with a bundle translating a different node, read in `en` and in `zh-CN`. All 4 cases served `{"en":"Orders","zh-CN":"订单"}`, and `saveAppMenu` stored `"label":"Sales orders"`. The premise holds. The committed suite keeps a pin of that served reading.

**Reach.** There are 0 inline-map navigation labels in `examples/**`, the showcase included, at 6a5b50dd. I grepped every app file for `label:` followed by an opening brace: crm 0 of 9 labels, todo 0 of 9, multi-package 0 of 11, showcase 0 of 58. The defect reaches only apps whose authors write such maps.

## Tests

A new top-level `describe` in the shared harness `designModeMenuSave-36363.test.ts`, per AGENTS.md's shared-harness rule. The served menu comes from the stored app through `translateApp`, with a catalog that walks the menu:

- the served label is the stored map itself, so the rename goes to the stored label
- `{ en: 'Orders', 'zh-CN': '订单' }` with source `en`, renamed in `en` to "Sales orders", stores `{ en: 'Sales orders', 'zh-CN': '订单' }`, and no translation is written
- an `en-US` session over an `en` key replaces `en`
- a map without a source entry gains `en`, and `zh-CN` is kept
- a cleared name stores `{ 'zh-CN': '订单' }`
- CONTROL: a plain-string stored label still becomes the plain typed string

<details><summary>Ablation (one-time, not kept)</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the merge branch's condition with `false` (anchor 1 → 0, blob dd3d8692 → a9d96821) and ran the `-t 36876` pins: **4 failed | 2 passed**. The 4 that failed are the map pins; for example, the received value was `"label": "Sales orders"` where the map was expected. The 2 that passed are the served-reading pin and the CONTROL, as expected. Restored: blob equals HEAD (dd3d8692), and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
</details>

<details><summary>Local runs at 6a5b50dd</summary>

- Scoped app-shell run under the verify lock: the 13 test files that import `designModeMenu*` / `DesignModeMenu` / `navItemLabel`. **Test Files 13 passed (13), Tests 235 passed (235)**, VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`, with the seven `@objectstack` packages built first as Test UI does. **Test Files 172 passed | 2 skipped (174), Tests 5129 passed | 2 skipped**, VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 38 commands, and each exited 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 38 derived, 38 run, 0 UNRUN.
- `overlap-check`: merges cleanly into origin/main, VERDICT clean, exit 0.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Declared narrowing.** The full app-shell suite (2425 test files) and `@object-ui/app-shell` type-check are left to CI (Test UI and Type Check UI).
  - Locally the type-check could not run: the `@object-ui/*` packages are not built in this worktree, so every import errors with TS2307 and every follow-on error is TS7006. None of the errors is in `designModeMenuModel.ts` or `designModeMenuSave.ts`.
  - A full-suite run was started and stopped to release the shared lock. The scoped run above covers every test that imports the touched modules.
- The cleared-name door gets the same treatment as the typed door. Clearing a source-language name over a map used to delete the whole map, the same loss through the other door. Now it drops only that entry. This uses the same helper pair at the same seam.
- Record tabs are out of scope, as the premise correction says: `relatedLists[].label` is `z.string()`, so no map can be stored there.

## Verification

Files to read first, ranked by risk:

1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/designModeMenuModel.ts`: the new `else if` branch in `splitLabelEdits`.
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/designModeMenuSave.ts`: the one-line call change.
3. The new `describe` at the end of `designModeMenuSave-36363.test.ts`.

Two-minute check: run `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/designModeMenuSave-36363.test.ts -t 36876`. Expect 6 passed.
